recalled.text: River gauge trigger fired for South Lhonak during cloudburst | When: 2026-08-14

The control room held the alerts and nobody was evacuated.

gauge|calm|1.label: Hold the alerts for up to 10 minutes: verify, then they go out automatically
gauge|calm|1.why: This source has false-alarmed 2 times before in the control room's memory, and radar now shows the lake stable (-2% change). Verify with a second source before alerting anyone. The hold lasts at most 10 minutes: the nearest place has 78 minutes, so the hold expires on its own: at the deadline the recommendation becomes SEND ALL NOW (sent automatically where the authority enables auto-escalation), and at once if a second source agrees.

bullets.heading: What happened
bullets.text: On 3 October 2023, South Lhonak lake in North Sikkim burst, releasing about 50 million cubic metres of water down the Teesta. The Teesta-III dam at Chungthang was destroyed, and 13 bridges were lost. The flood reached Chungthang 107 to 137 minutes after the landslide. Nobody downstream was warned.

bullets.heading: Which sources to trust
bullets.text: River gauge: 2 false alarms (2026-08-14, 2026-09-02); Lake station: 1 false alarm (2026-09-20). A radar drain (25% or more of the open water gone) overrides all of them.

bullets.heading: How long real actions take
bullets.text: Opening the spillway gates fully takes 18 minutes, so the Chungthang alert must reach the dam at least 25 minutes before the flood arrives. The Singtam message failed in a drill on 5 October 2026 due to an outdated phone number, which was corrected the same day.

bullets.heading: What failed and was fixed
bullets.text: The Singtam SMS drill failed on 5 October 2026 because the control room's phone number was outdated. The number was corrected the same day. The lake station alarm on 20 September 2026 was a false alarm caused by a low battery, which was replaced the same day.

bullets.heading: Open items
bullets.text: Repeat the Singtam SMS drill after the phone number was corrected. Owner: the district control room. Due 5 November 2026. Until then Singtam alerts must also be phoned through.
